scripts.build:prod: npm run clean && cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run build:js
scripts.i18n:make-pot: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/$(basename "$(pwd)")/ -- wp i18n make-pot . ./languages/wire-desk.pot --domain=wire-desk --exclude='assets,docs,node_modules,src,tests,vendor,.wordpress-org' --headers='{"Report-Msgid-Bugs-To":"https://github.com/JDeepD/wire-desk/issues"}'
scripts.i18n:make-json: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/$(basename "$(pwd)")/ -- wp i18n make-json languages/ --no-purge
scripts.i18n:make-mo: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/$(basename "$(pwd)")/ -- wp i18n make-mo languages/
scripts.i18n:make-php: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/$(basename "$(pwd)")/ -- wp i18n make-php languages/
scripts.i18n:update-po: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/$(basename "$(pwd)")/ -- wp i18n update-po languages/wire-desk.pot languages/
scripts.i18n:compile: npm run i18n:make-mo && npm run i18n:make-php && npm run i18n:make-json
scripts.lint:php:fix: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/$(basename "$(pwd)")/ composer run-script format
scripts.lint:php:stan: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/$(basename "$(pwd)")/ composer run-script phpstan
scripts.lint:php: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/$(basename "$(pwd)")/ composer run-script lint
scripts.perf: npm run wp-env:test -- run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/$(basename "$(pwd)")/ wp eval-file tests/performance/check.php --use-include
scripts.test:php: npm run wp-env:test -- run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/$(basename "$(pwd)")/ vendor/bin/phpunit -c phpunit.xml.dist
